stories.sourceTitle: NASA Selects 19 New Citizen Science Proposals in 2026
supportingPassages: So far, 2026 has seen a flood of successes for volunteers who do NASA science, exemplifying NASA’s commitment to gold-standard science—transparent, reproducible and intrinsically collaborative.
The Backyard Worlds: Planet 9 project announced that their project volunteers have now discovered most of the known brown dwarfs, celestial objects that are similar to planets.
The Zooniverse platform, with grant from NASA, reached a milestone of 1 billion classifications.

stories.sourceTitle: Sept. jobless rates down over the year in 226 of 387 metro areas; payroll jobs up in 11
supportingPassages: Unemployment rates were lower in September than a year earlier in 226 of the 387 metropolitan areas, higher in 138 areas, and unchanged in 23 areas, the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported today.
A total of 48 areas had jobless rates of less than 3.0 percent, and 5 areas had rates of at least 8.0 percent.
Over the year, employment decreased in Washington-Arlington-Alexandria, DC-VA-MD-WV (-1.8 percent).

stories.sourceTitle: FTC and States Take Action Against Toast Inc. over Hidden and Unauthorized Fees, Deceptive Subscription and Cancellation Practices and Other Unlawful Conduct
supportingPassages: Toast markets and sells point-of-sale hardware and software and payment processing services to small businesses in the restaurant industry.
Toast’s cloud-based products and services are used to take and manage orders, accept payments and track inventory, among other related services.
The FTC and state co-plaintiffs allege Toast deceives customers by imposing various types of fees on the cost of its hardware and software, which Toast fails to clearly disclose to its customers.
